items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: Yeah. That's Wood Wilson. He just died here about eight or nine months ago. I think he was ninety-eight or ninety-nine. He came here as a musician, too.

ctx.x: I counted forty-two musicians, plus--I guess that's probably a drum major there--the man in the white uniform.

Yeah. That's Wood Wilson. He just died here about eight or nine months ago. I think he was ninety-eight or ninety-nine. He came here as a musician, too. He was a bass player. It was the Wilson Brothers. Of course, they came here around...oh, about 1902 or '03 but they had two guitars, you know, and a bass violin, and, you know, those kind of things. And he was a bass player, and his brother was a guitar player, and they had two guitars or three guitars and a bass violin.
